researcher_notes:
Existing graph state checked first via `query-vendor` before any new research: vendor-presto and vendor-hi-auto each carry exactly one relationship, both to Checkers & Rally's, documenting the known vendor-switch (Presto's Hi-Auto-powered resale ended June 30 2024 per an SEC filing; Hi Auto's own direct relationship, 300+ locations, is production/active). Nothing else was in the graph for either vendor, and SoundHound AI, Valyant AI, ConverseNow, Coates Group, HME and Malcolm AI had no graph entries at all. All records below are NEW brand relationships not previously captured. The 2026-07-21 archive_registry/candidate_evidence pass had only two vendors in this category with real hits: 'coates' (2 usable McDonald's ANZ case-study URLs plus several false-positive keyword matches on 'Ward's'/'press' that were discarded) and 'soundhound' (16 indexed URLs, none surfaced as candidate rows — re-researched fresh via web/IR search instead, which was far more productive). 'presto' (3 indexed URLs) and 'conversenow' (6) produced no candidate_evidence rows either; also re-researched fresh.

MAJOR CORPORATE-STRUCTURE CORRECTION: the task brief's premise that 'SoundHound AI acquired Valyant AI in 2022' does not hold up against sourced evidence. No SoundHound-Valyant transaction was found anywhere (SEC EDGAR 8-K search, SoundHound's own newsroom, or general press). What actually happened: ConverseNow acquired Valyant AI, announced July 9, 2024 (thespoon.tech, privsource.com, restaurantbusinessonline.com all confirm), forming a combined company with a stated footprint of 2,000+ restaurants. Valyant's pre-acquisition named customers (CKE Restaurants' Carl's Jr. and Hardee's brands) and ConverseNow's pre-acquisition named customers (Domino's, Wingstop, Blake's Lotaburger, Fazoli's, Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza, Jet's Pizza) are recorded below under their respective original vendor names, since the evidence predates the merger and the products/brands were tracked separately at the time. Records are NOT double-counted between the two vendor lines. SoundHound AI remains fully independent, public (SOUN), and is by far the strongest vendor in this batch — its quarterly earnings releases (esp. Q3 2025, Nov 6 2025) name specific restaurant-chain wins exactly as the task brief anticipated.

Coverage by vendor: SoundHound AI is rich (15 dated relationships, several with explicit 'full/all locations' language from its own IR press releases and earnings materials). ConverseNow is solid (6 relationships) and Valyant AI (now absorbed into ConverseNow) contributes 2 more historical ones. Hi Auto has 4 new relationships beyond the already-graphed Checkers deal (Bojangles, Lee's Famous Recipe Chicken, Burger King New Zealand, Popeyes UK). Presto has 2 new relationships beyond Checkers (Carl's Jr., Hardee's — both from a May 2023 CKE pilot-expansion announcement; note an intermediate web-fetch pass mis-attributed the Checkers-specific '267 restaurants' figure to this CKE deal, which was caught and discarded on cross-check against the original May 4 2023 press release, which discloses no location count for the CKE pilot). Coates Group is thin but real: 2 McDonald's ANZ case studies (neither carries an explicit publish date on Coates' own site) plus one dated, well-scoped Hungry Jack's (Australian Burger King master franchisee) deployment. HME is thin and old, exactly as anticipated — six named-brand relationships exist in HME's own press-release archive, but all six date to 2010-2016 and are hardware/timer 'preferred vendor' or 'supplier of the year' relationships rather than AI; current status of any of them is unconfirmed. Malcolm AI returned zero evidence across multiple search strategies (company/product name, funding, drive-thru context) — flagged as unable to identify, not confirmed defunct.

A recurring pilot-vs-brand-wide caution applies throughout: several 'brand wide' or 'all locations' claims (Torchy's Tacos, Red Lobster, Popeyes UK, MOD Pizza, Habit Burger, Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza) are backed by explicit vendor-stated language and were promoted to all_location_deployment/brand_wide_deployment; many others (Church's Texas Chicken, Jersey Mike's, Wingstop, Bojangles, Burger King NZ, the CKE/Carl's Jr./Hardee's pilots) are explicitly scoped as pilots or partial rollouts and were kept at pilot_only/active_rollout/deployed_scope_not_publicly_disclosed rather than inferred upward.
